fields.name: title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Human-readable name for this player config (singleton — there is one Player).

fields.name: walkSpeed
fields.title: Walk speed (u/s)
fields.description: Base forward ground speed in units/s. Source player.gd SPEED_FORWARD. Backpedal/strafe are slower (3.25 / 5.2) and derive from this.

fields.name: turboMult
fields.title: Turbo multiplier
fields.description: Sustained-speed multiplier while the dash key (Shift) is held with forward input on the ground. Source player.gd TURBO_MULT (×2.0).

fields.name: jumpImpulse
fields.title: Jump impulse (u/s)
fields.description: Vertical launch velocity of a normal grounded jump. Source player.gd JUMP_FORCE (5.0). Super-jumps use MUTANT_JUMP_FORCE (4.0) instead.

fields.name: stamina
fields.title: Stamina (energy bar)
fields.description: The energy economy. Abilities (dash/slowmo/kick/slide) spend stamina; it regens slowly and is topped up by XP crystals.

fields.name: max
fields.title: Max stamina (bars)
fields.description: Base maximum stamina bars before level/stat bonuses. Source player_stats.gd BASE_MAX_STAMINA (4).

fields.name: costPerDash
fields.title: Cost per dash (bars)
fields.description: Stamina spent by a focus-dash. Source player.gd DASH_STAMINA_COST (1.0).

fields.name: regenPerSec
fields.title: Regen per second (bars/s)
fields.description: Base passive stamina regen. Source player.gd STAMINA_REGEN_PER_SEC = 1/19 ≈ 0.05263 (web 19s per bar). Speed-scaled up to 5× while sprinting.
